summary.text: Eddie Lumsden was elected in November 2012 and represents Georgia House District 12, which includes Chattooga County and part of Floyd County.

paragraphs.text: A lifelong Floyd County resident, Lumsden served six years in the U.S. Air Force/Air Guard and then had a 27-year career with the Georgia State Patrol, retiring as a master trooper in 1999.
Lumsden was twice elected to the Floyd County Commission and chaired it in 2010 and 2011.
